name: halfborg-campaign
description: A brand-agnostic, human-gated campaign engine for Claude Code. Turns a fuzzy marketing goal into a full set of campaign deliverables, reading everything brand-specific from a per-brand pack.

pixabay_key.title: Pixabay API key
pixabay_key.description: Optional. Lets the engine search free Pixabay stock footage for b-roll when it edits a talking-head short. Without a stock key the engine still plans the cutaways and gives you search links to pick clips yourself. Free key: log in at https://pixabay.com/api/docs/ and copy the key shown there.

pexels_key.title: Pexels API key
pexels_key.description: Optional, only if you already have one: Pexels is not issuing new keys at the moment, so use the Pixabay key instead. Lets the engine search free Pexels stock footage for b-roll as well. https://www.pexels.com/api/
